highlights: Child Protection Officers for Early Years, Primary, and Secondary
safety.policy_summary: MISB maintains a comprehensive Child Protection and Safeguarding Policy that aligns with the Thailand Child Protection Act B.E. 2546 (2003) and UK international best practice (Keeping Children Safe in Education). The school establishes a clear governance structure involving a Designated Safeguarding Lead, Deputy DSL, and Child Protection Officers across different school sections to ensure the welfare of the child remains paramount.
